description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMonday, May 4, 2026 PHOENIX, ARIZONA—After passing the Legislature this afternoon, Arizona Senate Republicans are sending Governor Hobbs a responsible, balanced FY 2027 budget that spends $800 million less than her proposal while delivering one of the largest tax cuts in state history: $1.45 billion in permanent, broad-based relief over four years. By
title: Senator Mark Finchem - Sen. Mark Finchem, Colleagues Pass Historic $1.45 Billion Tax Relief Budget
